# ModelPixLab

> Free AI image generator online powered by GPT Image 2.5 (Flare & Sunburst) and Nano Banana 2. Generate, sketch-to-image, and edit up to 4K images in your browser — no subscription required, commercial use permitted, new accounts get 3 free images with no credit card required.

ModelPixLab is an independent browser-based AI image generation and photo editing workspace. Homepage: https://modelpixlab.com/

## Core Tools & Workspaces

- [Free AI Image Generator Online | ModelPixLab](https://modelpixlab.com/): Main workspace for GPT Image 2.5 (Flare fast drafts & Sunburst precision editing) and Nano Banana 2 up to 4K (3840x2160) in PNG, JPEG, and WebP.
- [GPT Image 2.5 Generator - Free AI Image Creator Online](https://modelpixlab.com/gpt-image-2-5-generator/): Dedicated text-to-image and sketch-to-image generator powered by OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5 model.
- [Nano Banana 2: Free AI Photo Editor | ModelPixLab](https://modelpixlab.com/nano-banana-2-generator/): AI photo editing, multi-round detail preservation, object removal, style transfer, and background replacement.
- [Pricing - ModelPixLab](https://modelpixlab.com/pricing/): 3 free welcome images with no credit card required; pay-as-you-go credit packs (never expire) and monthly plans.
- [How to Use ModelPixLab - AI Image Generator Guide](https://modelpixlab.com/how-to-use/): Step-by-step workflow for text-to-image, sketch-to-image, and multi-round photo editing.
